messages:
lina: Quick heads-up 92were opening a very limited gated preview for MI700 Dedicated pools in Seattle (SEA) and Portland (PDX) next Tuesday 07:00 PT. Pilot customers only, capacity tiny. Please read the runbook before nominating pilots.

omar: Nice. Any special capacity policy or throttling we should call out up front?

lina: Two main changes: 1) per-tenant steady cap = 25% of pool; 2) were adding a short burst credit system (burst credits replenish 50% slower than MI600 policy). If credits depleted, traffic is throttled to baseline qps.

tess: Ops note: were also enabling per-workload cpu-side rate-limiter to prevent noisy CPU-bound preprocessing from starving inference. Default limiter = 200 reqs/min.

ryan: Runtime/drivers: MI700 requires driver 10.2.x+ and runtime shim 5.0. Private customers must upgrade control-plane and runtime before we route. Compatibility checklist and upgrade steps live in the runbook.

lina: Console/UI changes: Dedicated > Pools > MI700 (preview) has an "opt-in burst" checkbox and a small slider for burst_window (60-600s). CLI sample: 
```
redwood pools reserve --pool mi700-sea --capacity 2 --burst-window 300 --opt-in-burst true
```

billing-bot: Billing: preview discounted at 50% of GA reserved list. Preview usage will be tagged "mi700_preview"; burst consumption gets a separate line item "mi700_burst" so customers can see spend breakdowns. No SLA during preview.

omar: Migration guidance: start with minimal canaries, warm KV cache, set request_timeouts >= 100s for long-context models, and prefer bf16 model variants if available. Were enabling auto-fallback to MI600 pools when MI700 capacity is exhausted.

tess: Metrics and alerts: dashboards added under Dedicated > Pools > MI700 (preview). Watch p95_latency, burst_credit_balance, and cpu-rate-limit-throttles. Alert: burst_credit_balance < 10% for >5m triggers paging.

deploy-bot: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/mi700-sea-pdx-preview (internal) :link: 

lina: Pilot nominations: PMs/SEs, please DM me tenant ids + expected QPS. Ops will allocate weekday daytime windows and one nightly buffer per pilot. If youre on-call for SEA/PDX next week, please skim the runbook. :rocket:
